title: Peptide solubility record
description: One solubility measurement or observation for one peptide under one set of conditions. Fields marked x-provenance are filled by the agent, not the model.

peptide_name.description: Label used in the paper, e.g. 'P3', 'Aβ42', 'peptide 5'

sequence.description: Amino-acid sequence exactly as written (one- or three-letter code, including caps such as Ac- or -NH2)

modifications.description: Non-canonical or D-residues, PEGylation, lipidation, cyclisation, conjugates

solubility_operator.description: Relation of the true solubility to the reported value; '>' when fully dissolved at the highest concentration tested

solubility_unit.description: Unit exactly as written, e.g. 'mg/mL', 'µM', 'g/L', '% w/v'

method.description: Measurement method, e.g. 'turbidimetry', 'HPLC of supernatant', 'UV absorbance', 'visual inspection', 'computational'

solvent.description: Solvent or medium, e.g. 'water', 'PBS', '10% DMSO in water'

ionic_strength.description: Ionic strength or salt concentration as written

evidence.description: Shortest verbatim quote from the text that contains the value

confidence.description: Model's confidence (0-1) that the record is correct

notes.description: Anything needed to interpret the record (ranges, time to equilibrium, sample prep)

sequence_source.description: 'this passage', or the SI table the sequence was linked from by peptide label

sequence_one_letter.description: Canonical one-letter sequence; blank if non-canonical residues are present

calc_mw_g_mol.description: Average MW calculated from sequence and termini

solubility_mg_per_ml.description: Value converted to mg/mL (molar values use calc_mw_g_mol)

conversion_note.description: How or why not the value was converted

doi.description: DOI found on the first page or from search metadata

paper_title.description: Title from PDF metadata, search metadata, or file name

source.description: 'local file' or the search API used

location.description: Chunk within the file, e.g. 'p6 table 1', "sheet 'Table S2'"
